population_description: Synthetic ship-design records supplied as the complete nltl:ship population of each input. External legal/application eligibility and the experimental source-edition selection are research assumptions, not facts inferred from RDF. This is not real-vessel certification. The population includes incomplete, inconsistent and unrecognized-value records; represented correctness is not assumed. Conditions inside the represented requirement, effective activation, missing represented inputs, paths, units, datatypes and query correctness remain for generated SHACL to address from supplied source/schema. The represented domain is section 1.8 ice-class designation records, not an independent reconstruction of structure, propulsion power or navigational capability. External research eligibility is assumed for the supplied records; section 1.1 expressly applies section 1.8 irrespective of year of build. Designation validity is not assumed, and the source descriptions remain visible. No proof of an actual ship's class assignment or underlying capabilities is claimed.
